# A USD invoice posted to a CAD A/R account. Must be refused: the engine takes
# no exchange rate, writes the A/R split with amount 0, and the lot closes on
# its own posting date.
2026-01-01 open Assets
  type: Asset
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
  type: Accounts Receivable
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
  name: "US Customer"
  currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-BAD"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-BAD"
    accumulate: true
